tei:div.tei:p: (da)༄༅// rnam sras dkar po tshe 'phel gyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa bzhugs so// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti/ rnamaṃ kun skye med rtog pa'i myu gu ni// rin chen maṃng gang 'gro la 'dod 'jo'i slad// thoṃs pa'i mod la tshe yi mchog ster ba'i// sraṃs kyi thu bo'i tshul 'dzin mgon pos skyongs// zhes mchod par brjod nas/ 'dir rnam sras dkar po tshe 'phel gyi sgrub pa la gnyis/ rang gis sgrub pa dang*/ gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi'o// dang po ni/ gnas khang mtshan nyid dang ldan par dkon mchog gi rten spyi dang lhag par 'di'i rten rnams bshams pa'i drung du/ dkar gsum mngar gsum shas che ba las grub pa'i gtor ma khang brtsegs gsum rim dzam bshos brgyad kyis bskor ba dang*/ de'i mdun du rdul tshon dkar po'i maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi pa'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad dkar po mu khyud dang bcas pa'i lte bar bai dang*/ 'dab ma brgyad la k+ṣa re re bri/ de'i dbus su mañdzi'i steng du bum pa mtshan ldan bcud kyis gang zhing mgul chings can dung chos rdor gzungs kha rgyan dang bcas pa bsham/ maṇ+ḍal sogs ma grub na bum pa rkyang pa bshams kyang btub/ mdun du 'bul gtor zlum po/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod dang bcas pa bshams pa ni sbyor ba'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la'ang bdag mdun gnyis las dang po ni/ mchod pa byin rlabs spyi ltar sngon du 'gro bas skyabs sems/ tshad med bzhi bsgom/ swa bhā was stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las byung ba'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bang rim bzhi dang bcas pa/ de'i nang 'khor sa rim pa gsum la/ phyi ma la gnod sbyin bye ba'i tshogs dang*/ bar pa la stobs chen sum cu rtsa gnyis/ 'khor 'khyams dang po'i dbus na pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba la bai dang*/ 'dab ma brgyad la k+ṣa yig re re rnams kha dog dkar po/

de dag las 'od zer 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rnam thos sras dkar po tshe 'phel sku mdog gangs ri la nyi ma shar ba ltar dkar zhing 'od zer 'phro ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pas 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu dang*/ g.yon pas 'chi med bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa bsnams pa/ zhal 'dzum la chags pa'i nyams can/ rin po che'i rgyan du mas brgyan pa/ dbu la rigs bdag gi tshul du rin po che'i prog zhu bsnams pa/ 'dab ma brgyad la shar du dzaṃ bha la/ lhor gang ba bzang po/ nub tu nor bu bzang po/ byang du ku be ra/ shar lhor yang dag shes/ lho nub tu 'brog gnas/ nub byang du lngas rtsen/ byang shar du pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa li/ thams cad kyang sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas na tshe 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu dang*/ g.yon na 'chi med bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa bsnams shing rta dkar po la chibs pa/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar gtso bo la pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad dang*/ 'khor rnams la 'dab ma bzhi re yod pa'i pad+ma'i dbus su hūm̐ dang*/ 'dab ma rnams la bai3 re res mtshan pa/ de dag las 'od zer 'phros pas dkar po tshe 'phel 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs bstim/ bla ma dang yi dam dbyer med pas gtso 'khor thams cad kyi spyi bor rin po che'i cod pan bzhag par bsams la ngag tu rat+na mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ zhes brjod/ de nas rang gi snying ga'i mtha' skor du sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'chi med bdud rtsis rgyun byung*/ lus kyi nang khengs pas sdig sgrib dag cing tshe'i dngos grub thob par bsams la/ oṃ bh+rūm̐ ṇi ā yuḥṣe hūm̐ zhes ci nus bzlas la/ mthar 'khor dang gdan bsdu zhing dge ba bsngo ba sogs spyi ltar ro// yang rang gzhan gyi don du mdun bskyed la brten nas sgrub pa ni/

gtor ma bum pa rnams bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las byung ba'i bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan zhing nang chu dang bcud kyis gang ba'i nang dang*/ gtor ma khang bzang gi gnas su gzhal yas khang dang*/ lha rnams bskyed nas spyan drangs shing bstim pa dang*/ bzlas pa'i bar bdag bskyed ltar la bdag mdun gyi 'byin 'jug rnams ma nor bar bya/ bzlas pa ni/ oṃ bh+rūm̐ ṇi ā yuḥṣe hūm̐ ā yur+dz+nyā na sid+dhi a pa ri mi ta tshe bh+rūm̐ zhes ci nus bzla/ oṃ bai shra ma ṇa sa pa ri wā ra argaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ 'bul gtor 'bru gsum lan gsum gyis brlabs la/ mtshan sngags la a kā ro btags pa lnga'am gsum gyis phul/ gdong lnga nyi zla'i gdan steng du// bai las byung ba'i mgon po ni// sku mdog dkar po phyag gnyis pa// tshe 'gugs lcags kyu bum pa bsnams// 'chi med stsol la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod/ dung chos kyi mchod yon blugs pa'i rkyen gyis bum nang gi rten dang brten par bcas pa thams cad 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i bdud rtsis bum pa gang bar gyur par bsam/ bum pa de rang gi spyi bor bzhag nas bla ma dang yi dam dbyer med pas dbang bskur bas 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob par bsam mo// gnyis pa gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa rjes gnang dngos ni/ slob ma rnams khrus byas gral rim gyis 'khod pa la/ gong bshad rgyas bsdus ci rigs pa brjod nas/ rjes gnang zhu ba'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ gnod sbyin nor skyong rin chen lta bu'i sku// che mchog bsam gyis mi khyab yon tan ldan// sgrub mchog bdag la tshe dang ye shes kyi// dngos grub ma lus deng 'dir stsal du gsol// zhes lan gsum dang*/ spro na rgyun bshags lan gsum bya/ sku'i rjes gnang gi slad du/ slob ma rnams sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa'i gtso 'khor thams cad mngon rtogs ltar bskyed/

ye shes pa spyan drangs la slob ma la bstim zhing sngags rol bya/ gsung gi rjes gnang gi slad du/ slob mas/ bcom ldan bdag la sogs lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ slob dpon dkar po tshe 'phel du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ dang bai yig rnams las sngags kyi phreng ba mched/ zhal nas thon slob ma'i zhal du zhugs sems rgyud dang dbyer med du 'dres par bsams la/ yi ge bdun ma lan gsum rjes zlos byed du gzhug slob dpon gyis slob ma'i spyi bor me tog gtor la/ bcom ldan 'di la sogs brjod/ dam bca' ba'i lung spyi ltar bya/ thugs kyi rjes gnang gi sngar bsgrubs zin pa'i bum pa de slob ma'i mgo bor bzhag la/ oṃ bai shra ma ṇa ye bh+rūm̐ ṇi ā yuḥṣe hūm̐/ ā yur+dz+nyā na sid+dhi a pa ri mi ta tshe bh+rūm̐ zhes lan bdun bzlas la/ sbyin pa'i stobs kyis sangs rgyas yang dag 'phags// zhes sogs bden stobs brjod la bum chu 'thung du gzhug chu rgyun de snying ga'i ṇi dang hūm̐ la thim pas bde stong gnyis med rgyud la skyes par bsams la mnyam par bzhag gtor ma lhar gsal ba slob ma rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag la yi ge bdun ma dang*/ bla ma rnams kyi mtshan nas brjod cing bka' bsgo nan tan du byas pas/ rnam sras kyis kyang zhal gyis bzhes shing 'od du zhu nas slob ma'i spyi bo nas thim par bsams la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod/ rjes gtso bos ji ltar sogs dang*/ maṇ+ḍal sogs 'dra/ yig brgya lan gsum/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis bzod gsol bya/ brtan bzhugs dang*/ bkra shis bsngo smon sogs spyi ltar bya'o// tshe sgrub kyi las tshogs ni/ spyir sham bu bdun gyi dngos grub sgrub pa'i tshul las kyang*/ oṃ bai shra ma ṇa bi ru rā ga swā hā/ zhes pa/ 'bum phrag brgyad kyi sham bur ni// tshe spel sngags 'di gdags par gsungs// ā yuḥdz+nyā na yuḥtshe a pa ri mi ta sid+dhi sarba pha la hūm̐ swā hā/

sham bu 'di med bsnyen pas kyang*// bung bas sbrang rtsi bsags pa bzhin// bsags kyang gzhan gyis spyod par 'gyur// zhes gsungs la/ bye brag dkar po tshe 'phel la brten pa'i las tshogs ni/ de nas sgrub pa 'di bstan te/ gnod sbyin rgyal po'i tshe sgrub 'di// tshe dpal thams cad rgyas par byed// de yi rim pa 'di lta ste// dkyil 'khor mda' gang gru bzhi la// 'dab brgyad pad+ma mu khyud bcas// kha dog dkar po bri bar bya// de dbus rin chen bum pa ru// bdud rtsi lnga dang a mṛ ta// rin chen lnga dang snying po lnga// 'bru lnga mar gyi ril bur gzhug /tshe 'bras dag gis kha bcad la// mgul chings ras la g.yu gdags bya// gtor ma rin chen 'bar ba bsham// gzhan yang gnod sbyin mchod pa'i rdzas// 'byor tshad bshams pa man ngag yin// bdag nyid badz+ra pā ṇir bsgom// bh+rūm̐ las bum pa gzhal yas khang*// yangs shing mdzes pa bskyed par bya// a las nyi ma zla ba'i gdan// seng las seng ge'i gdan steng du// rgyal po bai las bskyed par bya// 'khor gyi gnod sbyin k+ṣa las bskyed// kun kyang sku mdog dkar po la// g.yas pa kun nas lcags kyu thogs// g.yon pa shel gyi bum pa bsnams// kha rgyan gser gyi rdo rje la// nang na tshe yi bdud rtsis gang*// kun gyis 'jig rten gang bar bsgom// spyan drangs bzhugs la gnyis med bstim// de bas bdag dang gnod sbyin gyi// thugs las 'od 'phros lcags kyu yis// tshe 'phrog bum par bstim par bya// sngags 'di brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas// oṃ bh+rūm̐ ṇi ā yuḥṣe hūm̐ dza zhes pas tshe bum gang bar bsam/ sngags 'dis bdag gi thugs kar bstim/ oṃ bh+rūm̐ ṇi ā yuḥṣe hūm̐ ā be sha ya hūm̐/ de nas tshe sgrub bstan pa ni/ oṃ bai shra ma ṇa ye bi ru rā ga ā yuḥtshe yuḥdz+nyā na bin dhu a ri mi ta tshe bh+rūm̐/ zhes bzlas sngar bskyed gnod sbyin gyis// sprul pa dang bcas 'jig rten gang*// bcud kyi sems can tshe dpal gang*// g.yas kyi lcags kyus bkug nas kyang*// g.yon gyi bum par bsdus byas nas// tshe yi rten du thim par bsam// de ltar tshe de grub pa yi// rtags ni tshe chang khol ba sogs// de ltar rtags bzang byung ba dang*// tshe bum dag ni spyi bor bzhag

/dmigs pa 'di ltar bsam par bya// phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa yi// sku gsung thugs las ye shes bcud// tshe yi bdud rtsir bsdus byas te// bum pa 'chi med bdud rtsis gang*// bdag gi tshangs pa'i bu ga nas// thugs nyi zla kha sbyor nang du thim// de nas ṇi la thim par bsam// ṇi dang yi ge oṃ āḥhūm̐// de yi nang nas yi ge hūm̐// cis kyang mi chod mi shigs pa// bde gshegs thugs dang mnyam par gyur// sngags 'di rang la thim par bsam// oṃ bh+rūm̐ āḥbh+rūm̐ yuḥbh+rūm̐ ṇi bh+rūm̐/ de nas tshe chang btung zhing zas la rol// tshe ni lo stong gnas par 'gyur// tshe sgrub med par rnam thos sgrub// gnod sbyin ma rungs pa rnams kyis// tshe las phri nas bsod nams skyed// tshe la bar chad 'byung srid pas// tshe sgrub byed pa shin tu gces// 'gro bzang snying po'i tshe sgrub ni// bar chad byung ba gcig kyang med// tshe yang tshangs pa dag dang mnyam// / gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na/ mdun du rgyal po 'khor bcas mngon rtogs ltar bskyed/ de thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin pa āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po bsam/ rang nyid phyag na rdo rjer gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pa'i sna la khro bo 'dod pa'i rgyal po sku mdog dmar po lcags kyu dang zhags pa thogs pa dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ byang phyogs lcang lo can nas rgyal po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ rang rang gi dam tshig pa la thim par bsam/ gu gul dkar po/ ga bur/ tsan+dan dkar po/ du ru ka a ka ru rnams sbyar ba'i ril bu bsreg de tsam ma 'byor na 'bras phye dang spos dkar gyi dud pa btang ngo*// de nas rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pa'am/ yang na dril bu gsil la/ mgon po kun gshegs thugs dam can// da lta snyigs ma lnga yi dus// thams cad nyon mongs 'dam bying bas// mtshams med lnga po kun spyod cing*// gzigs shing gshegs pa'i gnas ngan yang*// shākya seng ge'i spyan sngar khyod// thugs dam zhal bzhes de dgongs la// 'dren pa'i bstan pa srung ba dang*// sems can kun la sman slad du// byang phyogs gnas na bzhugs pa rnams// sems can don phyir gshegs su gsol// oṃ bai shra ma ṇa ye sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ bai shra ma ṇa ye ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes dang*/ bai3 ring po brjid dang ldan pa mig 'dzum sum cu so gnyis kyi tshad du brjod/ rgyal po rnams kyi thugs kar pad+ma 'dab brgyad re re la bai bzhi bzhi bsam zhing*/ rgyal chen 'khor bcas kyi thugs ka'i 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu dang*/ rang nyid phyag na rdo rjer gsal ba'i thugs ka'i 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu gnyis 'brel bar bsam/ de nas rin po che'i dbu rgyan gyis dbang bskur bar bsams la/ oṃ rat+na mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ zhes brjod/ 'dir mchod stod rgyas bsdus gang rung bya/ bzlas pa ni/ rgyal po'i thugs kar pad+ma dkar po'i lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rdo rje/ de'i lte bar bai dkar po/ gnod sbyin brgyad kyi thugs kar zla ba'i steng du k+ṣa re res mtshan pa'i mtha' skor la/ oṃ bh+rūm̐ ṇi ā yuḥṣe hūm̐/ zhes pas bskor ba/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ de'i sna la mchod pa'i sprin phung dpag tu med pa sprul te rgyal chen 'khor bcas mchod/ rā dza 'khor bcas kyi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer dang*/ phyag g.yas pa'i rdo rje lcags kyus/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang sems rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsi bkug nas rang la thim par bsams la/ oṃ bh+rūm̐ ṇi ā yuḥṣe hūm̐ dzaḥzhes ci nus bzla/ gtor ma ser chen ltar byin gyis brlabs la 'bul dus rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye nas/ ser chen gtso 'khor gyi snying po'am/ yang na bh+rūm̐ ṇi ā yuḥṣe hūm̐ dzā ya i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi btags pas phul kyang rung bas gang bde bya/ slar yang mchod bstod dang*/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskang*/ bzod par gsol/ de nas bai3 ring po mig 'dzum sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi bar du brjod/ yid kyi pad 'dab kyi bai rnams gshegs shing*/

bdag mdun gyi thugs ka'i 'od kyi lcags kyu grol bar bsam/ oṃ khyed kyi sems can don kun mdzad// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// byang phyogs yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang byon par mdzad du gsol// zhes brjod la mjug bsdu'o// // ༈ /'di'i rjes gnang skabs nyer mkho'i lo rgyus ni/ paṇa chen rin po che'i shākya mchog ldan dbus skyor mo lung gi chos grwar bzhugs skabs mkhan chen chos rgyal dpal bzang la rnam sras dkar po'i rjes gnang gsan dus/ mtshan ltas la mi dkar po dar dkar po'i gos gyon pa zhig gi phu dung nang nas/ 'gron bu dkar po mang po thu bar byin byung ba bgrangs pas brgyad cu tham pa 'dug sang de snga mor mkhan chen la zhus pas/ de khyed rang gi tshe'i tshad du 'dug gsung ba byung*/ phyis de ka bzhin paṇa chen rin po che dgung lo brgyad cu tham pa bzhugs/ paṇa chen nas brag dmar pa dang*/ glang thang spyan snga ba shākya rgyal mtshan la brgyud de tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos 'di'i rjes gnang dang yig lung rnams gsan/ da lta'i bar du paṇa chen gyi yig cha sor bzhag gis gnang ba lags so// de ltar rnam sras dkar po tshe 'phel gyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa 'di ni yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i bdag po thams cad mkhyen pa 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse dbang po phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i sdes 'di ltar gyis zhes bka'i cod can bde chen gyi 'khor lor stsal bar brten/ dam pa gang gi gsung gsang bdud rtsis 'tsho ba'i shākya'i dge sbyor gzim 'og sprul ming byams pa ngag dbang bstan 'dzin snyan grags sam/ brda sprod pa'i btags ming 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen mtsho byung dgyes pa'i blo gros su 'bod pas sbyar ba'o// ༈ /rnam sras dkar po tshe 'dzin gyi bstod pa tshe dpal bsod nams 'phel ba'i rol mo bzhugs so// bai/ rin chen bdun las grub pa'i khang pa brtsegs// kho ra khor yug grong dang skyed mos tshal// sum rtsen gnas bzhin nyams dga'i mkhar brgyad dbus// pho brang mchog tu bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/

1 /puṇ+ḍa rī ka'i sdong bu rgyas pa'i rtser// bsil sbyin ma zlum bzhad pa'i gdan steng du// ri dwags rgyal po gdong lnga 'bar ba'i lus// chibs rol ngal gsor skyong la phyag 'tshal lo/ 2 /zla zhun 'khyil ba'i mtsho ltar dar babs sku// 'od zer rba rlabs phyogs bcur 'khrugs pa can// nya rgyas bzhin gsal chu sgros dmar ba'i 'dzum// rngam zhing lang tsho rgyas la= 3 /spyan 'bras yid 'ong mdangs bkra hur zhing mdzes// smin ma 'khyog pos srid gsum dbang du sdud// snyan shal ring la mgul gyi bum pa mtshar// stobs ldan bsil ri 'dra la= 4 /cod pan rin chen nor bu'i phra tshom can// thor tshugs rtse mor 'od rgyas tog gis mtshan// snyan cha mu tig se mo sho shal sogs// lhab lhub rgyan gyis spras la= 5 /mchod sbyin brgya pa'i na bza' lha yi gos// gser gyi pa tra ris mtshan ya lad sogs// yid 'phrog sked 'ching dril bu g.yar kha'i phreng*// spud pa'i na bzas klubs la= 6 /phyag g.yas dbang gi nor bu'i lcags kyu yis// lha klu mi yi khams su zhen pa'i bcud// tshe g.yang bsod nams dpal gyi rdzogs ldan sprin// nye bar sdud bzhin g.yo ba la= 7 /g.yon pa zla shel gtsang ma'i ka la sha /tshe yi zil mngar bdud rtsi khol ba'i mtsho// lang long phyur dbus rdo rjes mtshan pa yis// 'gro ba'i 'chi bdag 'joms la= 8 /tshogs gnyis zla ba'i ma ma las 'khrungs pa'i// gsang gsum nyin byed yid kyi mkha' dbyings su// shar ba'i mod la rgud mun sangs pa yi// tshe dpal snang ba bskyed la= 9 /mgon po'i las sgrub rmugs 'dzin gang ba bzang*// nor bzang ku be ra can yang dag shes// lngas rtsen 'brog gnas pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa lī// tshe 'phel rta bdag brgyad la= 10 /gdengs can grong gnas lto 'gro nor 'dzin lha// brag ljongs gnod sbyin drang srong sde brgyad sogs// khams gsum gnas pa dkar po'i phyogs skyong ba// kun gyi sde dpon che la phyag 'tshal lo/

11 /tshe 'dzin lha khyod dges pa'i sprin chen las// tshe dpal bsod nams ye shes 'dod rgu'i char// ci 'dod bab nas bdag cag re ba'i sar// ci bsam 'grub pa'i lo tog 'phel rgyas mdzod/ 12 /ces rgyal chen rnam sras dkar po tshe 'dzin gyi bstod pa tshe dpal bsod nams 'phel ba'i rol mo zhes bya ba btsun pa blo gsal bstan skyong gis 'gal byed kyi lo snron zla'i tshes gnyis la zhwa lu ri phug tu bris pa'o// ༈ /rgyal chen rnam sras dkar po tshe 'dzin gyi bla ma brgyud pa'i byin 'bebs 'chi med char 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru we/ tshe sgrub bla brgyud spyan 'dren byin 'bebs ni/ mda' bya rgod ma la gser g.yus brgyan cing dar tshon sna lnga btags pa lag tu khyer nas g.yabs la dbyangs dang bcas pa'am/ med kyang rung ste 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o// 'og min lcang lo can gyi pho brang nas// gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje yang*// bdag la brtser dgongs mdun gyi nam mkhar byon// tshe 'dzin lcags kyus tshe g.yang khugs mdzod la// bdud rtsi'i bum pas tshe yi bdag mchog stsol// gzhan don du dbang bskur ba sogs kyi tshe// skal ldan bu la tshe skyobs srog skyobs shig /chos dbyings bde ldan zhing gi pho brang nas// spyod mdzad chos kyi rdo rje kun bzang yang*// bdag la= /tshe 'dzin= /bdud rtsi'i= /gur gum mdangs bzang bkra ba'i grong khyer nas// bram ze 'gro bzang bh+riṃ kar dgon pa ba// bdag la= /tshe 'dzin= /bdud rtsi'i= /byang phyogs chu mig ring mo'i lha khang nas// zangs dkar lo tsā 'phags pa shes rab kyang*// bdag la= /tshe 'dzin= /bdud rtsi'i= /g.yer po dge tshal 'jad phu la sogs nas// jo ston bcur bsod pad+ma bkra shis kyang*// bdag la= /tshe 'dzin= /bdud rtsi'i= /thang bu mang gi gnas mchog dam pa nas// lha rje stag pa jo bzang chen po yang*// bdag la=

/tshe 'dzin= /bdud rtsi'i= /byams chen lha gnas khro phu'i dgon pa nas// khro lo yab sras rin chen seng ge yang*// bdag la= /tshe 'dzin= /bdud rtsi'i= /dga' ldan mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing khams nas// kun mkhyen bu ston chos kyi rgyal po yang*// bdag la= /tshe 'dzin= /bdud rtsi'i= /chos tshul skad gnyis bsgyur ba'i gdan sa nas// shāka bzang 'jam dpal ngag dbang grags pa yang*// bdag la= /tshe 'dzin= /bdud rtsi'i= /yul dbus skyor mo lung gi chos grwa nas// chos kyi rgyal mtshan shākya mchog ldan yang*// bdag la= /tshe 'dzin= /bdud rtsi'i= /legs bshad khu byug sgrogs pa'i dga' tshal nas// kun dga' che 'phel shākya rgyal mtshan yang*// bdag la= /tshe 'dzin= /bdud rtsi'i= /dpal ldan zhwa lu'i gser khang phra mo nas// tshar chen mkhyen brtse dbang phyug rab brtan yang*// bdag la= /tshe 'dzin= /bdud rtsi'i= /ri phug gzim khang rnam grol yang rtse nas// gnas gsar mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan yang*// bdag la brtser dgongs mdun gyi nam mkhar byon// tshe 'dzin lcags kyus tshe g.yang khug mdzod la// bdud rtsi'i bum pas tshe yi dbang mchog stsol// yar lung bkra shis chos sde'i bla brang nas// 'khor lo'i mgon po blo gsal mchog ldan yang*// bdag la= /tshe 'dzin= /bdud rtsi'i= /bsil ldan sman ljongs yangs pa'i lte ba nas// mang thos rgya mtsho 'jam dbyangs bde rdor yang*// bdag la= /tshe 'dzin= /bdud rtsi'i= /gru 'dzin dmar po'i ri yi pho brang nas// spyan ras gzigs dbang skal bzang rgya mtsho yang*// bdag la= /tshe 'dzin= /bdud rtsi'i= /gtsang stod zhwa lu'i dben gnas dam pa nas// rin chen don grub lce btsun yab sras kyang*// bdag la= /tshe 'dzin= /bdud rtsi'i= /mos gus gzhom med chos kyi pho brang nas// rtsa ba'i bla ma ye shes dpal 'byor yang*// bdag la= /tshe 'dzin= /bdud rtsi'i= /dbus kyi ri rgyal lhun po'i byang phyogs nas// rgyal chen rnam sras tshe 'phel lha tshogs kyang*// bdag la brtser dgongs mdun gyi nam mkhar byon// tshe 'dzin lcags kyus tshe g.yang khug mdzod la// bdud rtsi'i bum pas tshe yi dbang mchog stsol// skal ldan bu la tshe skyobs srog skyobs shig

/oṃ bh+rūm̐ ṇi ā yuḥṣe hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes snying po dang*/ oṃ bh+rūm̐ ṇi ā yuḥṣe hūm̐/ ā be sha ya hūm̐/ oṃ bai shrā ma ṇa ye bi ru rā ga ā yuḥtshe yuḥ dz+nyā na bin+du a pa ri mi ta tshe bh+rūm̐/ zhes tshe sgrub dbang bskur ba'i sngags dang*/ oṃ bh+rūm̐/ āḥbh+rūm̐/ yuḥbh+rūm̐/ ṇi bh+rūm̐/ zhes tshe chang blud pa'i sngags su bshad do// rnam sras dkar po tshe 'phel gyi bla ma brgyud pa'i byin 'bebs bya tshul btsun pa blo gsal ri khrod pas yi ger bkod pa'o// ༈ /rgyal chen rnam thos sras dkar po tshe 'dzin gyi rgyun khyer 'chi med snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti sid+dhi rastu/ rnam thos sras kyi tshe sgrub ni/ skyabs sems sngon 'gros stong pa'i ngang*// rang nyid phyag na rdo rje yi// nga rgyal brtan pos 'di ltar bsgom// rang mdun nam mkhar pad dkar zla nyi'i steng*// siṃ las seng ge de steng bai yig dkar// 'od 'phros 'phags tshogs mchod dang 'gro kun gyi// tshe nyams gsos nas tshur 'dus yongs gyur las// rgyal chen rnam sras tshe 'dzin sku mdog dkar// zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pa tshe'i lcags kyu// g.yon pa shel dkar bum bzang tshe bcud kun// gser gyi rdo rjes mtshan pa thugs kar 'dzin// zhal bzang zla rgyas ltar mdzes khro chags 'dzum// rin chen rgyan spras rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs// 'dab brgyad steng du k+ṣa yig dkar po las// dzam+bha la sogs gnod sbyin rta bdag brgyad// sku mdog phyag mtshan gtso bo dang mtshungs pa// kun kyang rta dkar chibs kyi gdan steng bzhugs// gnas gsum yi ge gsum mtshan hūm̐ yig gis// 'od dmar spros pa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥthim// rgyal po'i thugs kar pad dkar zla ba'i steng*// rdo rje'i lte bar bai yig dkar po dang*// 'khor gyi thugs kar zla steng k+ṣa yig dkar// sngags kyis bskor bas 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros// tshe mdangs yar ba 'byung bzhi 'khor 'das bcud// bsdus te gtso 'khor phyag gi bum par bstims// de las lud nas rang gi tshangs bug zhugs// 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub thob par gyur// oṃ bh+rūm̐ ṇi āḥyuḥṣe hūm̐ dzaḥ

zhes bzla/ gtor ma/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin rlabs bya/ 'bru gsum 'od kyis ma dag skyon sbyangs nas// 'dod yon lnga ldan bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur// 'od zer sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud drangs te// gsol bas 'khor bcas dgyes shing tshim par gyur// oṃ bh+rūm̐ ṇi ā yuḥṣe hūm̐ dzaḥ i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan lnga'am bdun gyis dbul/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ yid 'phrog kai la sha yi ri bo la// nyi gzhon bye bas 'khyud pa'i gzi brjid can// dran pa tsam gyis 'chi bdag kun 'joms pa// rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la bstod par bgyi// dus min 'chi ba'i dgra las rnam rgyal nas// lus stobs kha dog gzi mdangs rab rgyas shing*// dam chos sbyong ba'i lus ni ring du 'tsho// tshe la gnod med rab tu rgyas par mdzod// de ltar gsol btab rgyal chen 'khor bcas kyi// dngos grub bsdus nas rang gi snying ga'i dbus// dkar dmar thig le'i nang gi tshe srog rten// nṛ yig la thim gnyug ma'i ngang du bsre// nṛ yig mar me'i rtse ltar 'bar ba de// oṃ dkar āḥdamar hūm̐ sngon la thim pas// rang rig gzhom med hūm̐ dang bde gshegs thugs// dbyer med mi chod mi shigs brtan par gyur// brjod bral bde ba chen po'i nyams kyi rtsal// mi 'gags ci yang 'char ba'i rten 'brel gshis// dpal ldan bla ma mchog dang mi gnyis pa'i// nor skyong tshe 'dzin dbang po 'grub par shog /mdun gyi mgon po'i ye shes pa// 'od zer lcags kyu'i sbrel ba bkrol// rang gnas gshegs shing dam tshig pa// bdag gi snying gar e ma ho// bram ze 'gro bzang snying po'i tshe sgrub 'di// rgyal chen rnam sras sgrub la med thabs med// gzhan du 'di yis bsod nams skyed gyur kyang*// gnod sbyin gdug pas tshe 'phrog 'byung bar 'gyur// de phyir tshe 'dzin dkar po'i rgyun 'khyer 'di// bya bral dge slong blo gsal bstan skyong gis// dpal ldan zhwa lu'i dben gnas ri phug tu// bris pa'i dge bas phan bde kun 'grub shog/
